title: CIRAS: confidential safety hotline for transport worker concerns
summary: CIRAS is encoded as a transport-sector confidential reporting infrastructure: it protects identity, routes concerns to the right people to act, and aims to surface information that member organizations might otherwise miss.

status_history.note: Promoted in rev0007 as a source-infrastructure record for the near-miss / signal-capture lane.

claims.claim: CIRAS describes itself as listening to health and safety concerns from people working in UK and ROI transport, protecting reporter identity when sharing concerns with people positioned to act, and providing safety information members might otherwise miss.
what_would_change_status: CIRAS changes jurisdiction, confidentiality model, or operating scope.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

claims.claim: RSSB describes CIRAS as the confidential safety hotline for transport, operating impartially and independently of members, connecting companies with information that might otherwise stay hidden, and accepting concerns from anyone in transport about any company, not only the reporter’s employer.
what_would_change_status: RSSB changes CIRAS ownership, independence statement, or report eligibility.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

claims.claim: CIRAS reporting service is represented as entirely confidential and always protecting reporter identity and the identity of others involved in a concern.
what_would_change_status: CIRAS policy statements or legal cases materially change the confidentiality guarantee.

evidence_migration.note: rev0016 removes overloaded source_support.source_id/record_id keys and uses typed evidence_refs with ref_kind and support_role.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official/institutional HTML extraction; no outcome evaluation or database sampling yet
limitations: This record establishes infrastructure existence, stated purpose, and reported process; it does not estimate effectiveness, representativeness, underreporting, or downstream safety impact.
No reporter narratives are imported in rev0007; privacy and de-identification boundaries are preserved.

type_payload.jurisdiction_or_scope: UK and Republic of Ireland transport sector, with RSSB/CIRAS membership context
signal_capture_model: routing to relevant company or people positioned to act
reporter_protection_design: identity protection when concern is shared
limitations: records do not yet sample individual reports or closure outcomes
not all concerns are necessarily near-misses or incidents
type_payload.query_value: Makes worker voice a first-class source path rather than treating official accident reports as the only mature safety corpus.

handling_notes: Do not attempt to re-identify reporters or named parties from confidential/de-identified reporting systems.
Infrastructure records are not evidence that all weak signals were handled well or that a reporting system prevented a specific accident.
Preserve distinction among mandatory reporting, voluntary self-reporting, confidential concern reporting, accident investigation, and recommendation tracking.

unknowns: Quantitative uptake, underreporting, signal quality, follow-through rates, and confidentiality failure history are not extracted yet.
No sample of individual reports, alerts, recommendations, or closed actions has been coded yet.
next_actions: Add database/export sampling plan and legal/ethical handling rules before importing any de-identified report narratives.
Add outcome or follow-through records showing when a report led to action, when it did not, and when confidentiality or reporting incentives failed.
Cross-link with warning-governance cases only when a source shows a specific relation; do not infer relation from infrastructure existence.

revision_history.change: Claim support migrated to typed evidence_refs; factual claim text and statuses unchanged.
